dialogues.speaker: Chihu Rock Bulletin Board
dialogues.text: This is the Chihu Rock Bulletin Board. You can find community news and shop advertisements posted here. Please do not post unimportant matters.

dialogues.speaker: Millelith Announcement
dialogues.text: Most mining at the Chasm has been shut down, but illegal mining and smuggling activity has increased recently.

dialogues.speaker: Millelith Announcement
dialogues.text: We urge Liyue residents to take extra caution and cooperate with Millelith soldiers as they work to apprehend the smugglers.

dialogues.speaker: Millelith Announcement
dialogues.text: Jade vendors should similarly strictly abide by the law. Heavy fines will be issued to anyone engaging in the sale of smuggled minerals.
